in_greek.name: Αφροδίτη
in_greek.long_meaning: Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of love, beauty, pleasure, and procreation. She was born from the sea foam created by Cronus castrating Uranus.

in_latin.name: Venus
in_latin.long_meaning: Venus is the Roman goddess of love, beauty, desire, fertility, and prosperity. She is often depicted as a naked woman holding an apple or a mirror.
